{{- /* layouts/_partials/breadcrumbs.html CAP-07: Breadcrumb navigation (conditional). Activation: Global: [params] breadcrumbs = true in config.toml Per-page: breadcrumbs: false in front-matter to disable Placement: call at top of single.html define "main", or via slot-before-main block. CSS class: .mdf-breadcrumbs — override in sub-theme main.css. v2.2: baseURL-aware — strips deploy prefix (e.g. /subfolder/) from path segments. */ -}} {{- if and (not .IsHome) (.Params.breadcrumbs | default .Site.Params.breadcrumbs) -}} {{- $baseURL := .Site.BaseURL | default "/" -}} {{- $baseURLPath := "" -}} {{- if ne $baseURL "/" -}} {{- $u := urls.Parse $baseURL -}} {{- $baseURLPath = $u.Path | strings.TrimPrefix "/" | strings.TrimSuffix "/" -}} {{- end -}}
{{ .Site.Title }} › {{- range .Ancestors.Reverse -}} {{- if not .IsHome -}} {{- $title := .Title -}} {{- $url := .RelPermalink -}} {{ $title }} › {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{ .Title }}
{{- end -}}
